context_requirements: Expression of the relevant PDE isozyme (e.g., PDE4A/B/D for cAMP-elevating inhibitors, PDE5A for cGMP-elevating inhibitors)
Intact cAMP/PKA or cGMP/PKG signaling to translate cyclic nucleotide elevation into transcriptional changes
A cell context where cAMP/PKA activation can inhibit proliferation or induce differentiation (e.g., glioma, epithelial cancer lines)
For PDE5 inhibitors, presence of nitric oxide/cGMP signaling components (e.g., NOS3, soluble guanylate cyclase)
falsifiers: No consistent change in cAMP/PKA-responsive genes (e.g., FOS, JUN, EGR1, CDKN1A) at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
No reduction in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA) at 24 h in responsive lines
Strong and uniform upregulation of generic stress markers (HSPA1A, DNAJB1) without cAMP/PKA target changes, suggesting non-specific toxicity
Lack of any transcriptional response across all nine lines at both time points

evidence.supports: PDE4 inhibitor rolipram induces p21(Cip1) and p27(Kip1), inhibits proliferation, and causes G1 block in A-172 glioma cells
PDE5 inhibitor sildenafil reduces inflammation and apoptosis in a rat renal damage model
PDE5 inhibitor sildenafil modulates microglial neuroinflammation after neonatal stroke
PDE inhibitor ibudilast suppresses TNF-alpha and inflammation in a demyelination model

changes: Removed CDKN1A and CDKN1B from late_up because the cited PDE4 inhibitor evidence (PMID 12432276) shows p21/p27 induction in glioma cells, not in the nine profiled lines; keeping them would overstate line-specific support.
Removed MCM3 and RFC2 from late_down because no cited abstract supports PDE inhibition reducing these replication genes.
Removed HSPA1A and DNAJB1 from generic_effects because they are not in the allowed generic effect list and are not supported by the PDE inhibitor abstracts.
Changed kinetics from slow to moderate because cAMP/PKA transcriptional responses (e.g., FOS, JUN, EGR1) are typically rapid, while p21/p27 induction can occur by 24 h.
Changed magnitude 6h from weak to moderate because immediate-early cAMP/PKA target genes can respond within hours.
Changed line_response for A549, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7 from moderate to weak because the cited abstracts do not provide line-specific PDE expression or cAMP/PKA responsiveness data for these lines.
Changed line_response for PC3 and VCAP from weak to moderate because prostate cancer lines can express PDE4 and respond to cAMP elevation, but direct evidence is limited.
Removed the unsupported claim that PDE5 inhibitors require NOS3/soluble guanylate cyclase from context_requirements because the cited abstracts do not establish this as a general requirement.
